signature: SUBROUTINE ZLARZT( DIRECT, STOREV, N, K, V, LDV, TAU, T, LDT )

params.name: direct
params.reference:
Specifies the order in which the elementary reflectors are multiplied to form the block reflector:

-   `= 'F'`: $H = H(1)$ H(2) . . . H(k) (Forward, not supported yet)
-   `= 'B'`: $H = H(k)$ . . . H(2) H(1) (Backward)

params.name: storev
params.reference:
Specifies how the vectors which define the elementary reflectors are stored (see also Further Details):

-   `= 'C'`: columnwise                        (not supported yet)
-   `= 'R'`: rowwise

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the block reflector H. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: K
params.reference: The order of the triangular factor T (= the number of elementary reflectors). $K \ge 1$.

params.name: V
params.reference: (`LDV`,N) if `STOREV = 'R'` The matrix V. See further details.

params.name: ldv
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array V. If `STOREV = 'C'`, $\mathrm{LDV} \ge \max (1,N)$; if `STOREV = 'R'`, $\mathrm{LDV} \ge K$.

params.name: TAU
params.reference: `TAU(i)` must contain the scalar factor of the elementary reflector H(i).

params.name: T
params.reference: The k by k triangular factor T of the block reflector. If `DIRECT = 'F'`, T is upper triangular; if `DIRECT = 'B'`, T is lower triangular. The rest of the array is not used.

params.name: ldt
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array T. $\mathrm{LDT} \ge K$.
